description: This file defines a PHP class 'User' in the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing user accounts through various actions such as listing, creating, editing, deleting, enabling, disabling, and authorizing users. It includes functions for rendering views, handling form submissions, permissions checks, and interacting with models for user data operations.

classes.name: User
classes.description: The User class manages user account operations within the OpenCart admin interface, providing CRUD functionalities, status updates, authorization management, and login history tracking for administrator users.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up the user list view, including filters, breadcrumbs, and action URLs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of users, typically used as a route handler.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Constructs and returns the HTML view for the user list with filtering, pagination, and links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating a new user or editing an existing user.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission for adding or updating a user, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected users by updating their status.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected users by updating their status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected users after permission verification.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Retrieves authorization records for a user with pagination.

methods.name: deleteAuthorize
methods.description: Deletes a specific user authorization record, enforcing logout if necessary.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Displays login history for a user.

methods.name: getLogin
methods.description: Retrieves login records for a user with pagination.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an autocomplete JSON response for user search based on username, name, or email.
